other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Assam.
The applicant must be engaged in any building and other construction work.
The construction worker must be registered with the Assam Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and have an active membership with the Board.
The applicant must be permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, TB, accident, or similar causes.
benefits_summary: A monthly disability pension of ₹2,000 plus ₹100 for each completed year of service, and a one‑time ex‑gratia payment of up to ₹3 Lakhs depending on the disability percentage.
